title: The Waltons
description: The faith of the Walton family is sorely tried when Olivia contracts polio, and the doctor says that she may never walk again.

title: The Waltons
description: Olivia tries a radical polio treatment developed by Sister Kenny of Australia.

title: The Waltons
description: John-Boy heads for a mountain cabin to write, but ends up delivering an old schoolmate's (Sissy Spacek) baby.

title: The Holiday Sitter
description: Sam is a workaholic bachelor who's babysitting his niece and nephew during the holidays. Completely out of his element, he recruits help from a handsome neighbor and soon finds himself in an unexpected romance.

title: A Family Christmas Gift
description: When Amber spends the holidays with her Aunt Dora and helps plan a fundraising Christmas Concert, it brings Amber closer to her aunt and a new love into her life.

title: A Perfect Christmas
description: Newlyweds Steve and Cynthia have a few secrets to keep as their families arrive for the holidays: he's just been laid off, and she's pregnant.

title: Christmas Everlasting
description: Christmas is fast approaching and years of long workdays are about to pay off for Lucy. However, when her older sister unexpectedly passes away, Lucy dreads returning to Nilson's Bay to handle her sister's estate.

title: Holiday Heritage
description: Ella returns to her hometown to mend fences with her fractured family. With help from her ex-boyfriend, she encourages her family to celebrate Christmas and Kwanzaa and heal their past wounds before it's too late.

title: Our Christmas Journey
description: As a single mom and her teenage son come to a crossroad during Christmas, she must learn to let go so he can flourish as she finds her own heart healing in unexpected ways.

title: Christmas in Evergreen: Bells Are Ringing
description: As Michelle's wedding approaches, Hannah steps up to finish the new Evergreen museum's launch while questioning her future with Elliot.

title: Meet Me at Christmas
description: A woman tries to coordinate her son's Christmas Eve wedding with help from the bride's uncle.

title: A Gingerbread Romance
description: An architect begins to find herself longing for a place to call her own as she works alongside a baker to win a gingerbread house contest.

title: A Heavenly Christmas
description: A workaholic's (Kristin Davis) untimely death leads to her recruitment as a Christmas angel. Her first task is to help a struggling singer (Eric McCormack) use his music to heal old wounds.

title: A Majestic Christmas
description: An architect returns to her hometown during the holidays to turn a historic playhouse into a modern multiplex, much to the town's objections.

title: The Christmas Bow
description: When an accident puts her music dreams on hold, a gifted violinist reconnects with an old family friend, who helps her heal and find love during the holidays.

title: Christmas in Harmony
description: A music executive heads home to North Carolina to win her job back while also co-directing the church choir with her ex-boyfriend.

title: Sister Swap: A Hometown Holiday
description: Two sisters find a new sense of purpose and discover what they both truly need in life during the holidays.

title: The Christmas House
description: Working through some difficult decisions, a mother and father summon their two grown sons home for the holidays.

title: My Christmas Love
description: A hopeless romantic (Meredith Hagner) begins receiving the gifts from The 12 Days of Christmas from an anonymous suitor.

title: Catch a Christmas Star
description: A widower reconnects with his high school sweetheart, one of the country's biggest pop stars, with help from his two children.

title: Christmas List
description: Isobel makes a carefully composed bucket list of classic holiday traditions to celebrate with her boyfriend. But when he goes AWOL, the list proves challenging and a tempting new romance turns her life upside down.

title: The Mistletoe Inn
description: When an aspiring author is dumped by her soon-to-be-published novelist boyfriend, she decides to take a leap of faith and signs up for a romance writing retreat at a quaint Vermont Inn shortly before Christmas.
